problem_en: Pipe A fills a tank in 12 hours, and Pipe B fills it in 15 hours. A third Pipe C empties it in 20 hours. Pipe A is opened at 7 AM, Pipe B at 9 AM, and Pipe C at 10 AM. At what time will the tank be completely filled?
problem_hi: पाइप A एक टैंक को 12 घंटे में भरता है, और पाइप B इसे 15 घंटे में भरता है। एक तीसरा पाइप C इसे 20 घंटे में खाली करता है। पाइप A को सुबह 7 बजे, पाइप B को सुबह 9 बजे और पाइप C को सुबह 10 बजे खोला जाता है। टैंक किस समय पूरी तरह भर जाएगा?
problem_hg_030: Pipe A tank ko 12 hours mein fill karta hai, aur Pipe B 15 hours mein. Ek third Pipe C 20 hours mein empty karta hai. Pipe A subah 7 AM pe open kiya, Pipe B 9 AM pe, aur Pipe C 10 AM pe. Tank kis time tak full ho jayega?
problem_hg_065: Pipe A tank ko 12 ghante mein bharta hai aur B 15 ghante mein. Ek exit pipe C 20 ghante mein khali karta hai. Pehle karo A open 7 AM pe, phir B 9 AM pe, phir C 10 AM pe sequence mein. Tank kab full hoga?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Assume capacity of tank = LCM(12, 15, 20) = 60 units.
Step 2: Efficiency of A = +5, B = +4, C = -3 units/hr.
Step 3: From 7 AM to 9 AM (2 hrs), A fills 5 * 2 = 10 units. From 9 AM to 10 AM (1 hr), A and B fill (5+4) * 1 = 9 units. Total filled = 19 units.
Step 4: Remaining work = 60 - 19 = 41 units. Combined efficiency after 10 AM = 5 + 4 - 3 = 6 units/hr.
Step 5: Time taken after 10 AM = 41 / 6 = 6 hours 50 minutes.

Final: 10 AM + 6 hrs 50 min = 4:50 PM. (Wait, let me fix the specific example to 1:00 PM logic: 41/6 is 6.83. For 1 PM, remaining needs to be 18. 60 - 42. If A=5, B=4, C=-3. 3 hrs of A (15) + 2 hrs of B (8) = 23. 60-23=37. 37/6... Adjusting numbers: Let capacity be 60. A=5, B=4, C=-3. If filling takes 3 hours after C opens. 60 - 18 = 42. 2 hrs of A (10) + 1 hr of A+B (9) = 19. 60-19=41. 41/6 = 6h 50m. Calculation verified.)
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: pehle karo phir; sequence matters; LLM may swap the operations
why_hard: Requires tracking state changes at three different time intervals with net flow rate updates.

problem_en: Three pipes A, B and C can fill a cistern in 10, 15 and 30 hours respectively. All pipes are opened together. After 3 hours, pipe C is closed and after another 1 hour, pipe B is also closed. In how many total hours will the cistern be full?
problem_hi: तीन पाइप A, B और C एक टंकी को क्रमशः 10, 15 और 30 घंटों में भर सकते हैं। सभी पाइप एक साथ खोले जाते हैं। 3 घंटे बाद, पाइप C बंद कर दिया जाता है और अगले 1 घंटे बाद, पाइप B भी बंद कर दिया जाता है। टंकी कुल कितने घंटों में भर जाएगी?
problem_hg_030: Teeno pipes A, B aur C ek cistern ko 10, 15 aur 30 hours mein fill kar sakte hain. Saare pipes saath mein open kiye gaye. 3 hours baad Pipe C close kiya aur 1 hour baad Pipe B bhi close kiya. Total kitne hours lagenge?
problem_hg_065: A, B, C can fill in 10, 15, 30h. Teeno open kiye saath mein. 3 hours baad C band kiya, then 1 hour baad B withdraw kar liya N mahine baad logic, remaining kaam A karega. Total time batao?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Capacity = 30 units. Eff A = 3, B = 2, C = 1.
Step 2: For first 3 hours, A+B+C = (3+2+1)*3 = 18 units filled. Remaining = 12 units.
Step 3: For next 1 hour, A+B = (3+2)*1 = 5 units filled. Remaining = 7 units.
Step 4: Remaining 7 units filled by A alone = 7 / 3 = 2.33 hours.
Final: Total time = 3 + 1 + 2.33 = 6.33 hours.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: withdraw kar liya N mahine baad; timing in compound interest; LLM applies wrong
why_hard: Double phase change with cumulative time tracking for a single worker.

problem_en: A tank has two pipes. Pipe A can fill it in 15 hours and pipe B can empty it in 25 hours. If both pipes are opened on alternate hours starting with Pipe A, how much total time will it take to fill a tank of 375000 liters capacity?
problem_hi: एक टैंक में दो पाइप हैं। पाइप A इसे 15 घंटे में भर सकता है और पाइप B इसे 25 घंटे में खाली कर सकता है। यदि दोनों पाइपों को पाइप A से शुरू करते हुए बारी-बारी से घंटों में खोला जाता है, तो 375000 लीटर क्षमता वाले टैंक को भरने में कुल कितना समय लगेगा?
problem_hg_030: Ek tank mein do pipes hain. Pipe A 15 hours mein fill kar sakta hai aur Pipe B 25 hours mein empty. Agar dono pipes alternate hours pe open hon (starting with A), toh 375000 liters ka tank kab bharega?
problem_hg_065: Tank capacity is 3 lakh 75 hazaar liters. Pipe A 15h mein bharta hai, B 25h mein khali karta hai. Alternate hours pe kaam ho raha hai starting with A. Total kitne hours lagenge?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Total units = LCM(15, 25) = 75 units. Eff A = +5, B = -3.
Step 2: In one cycle (2 hours), net fill = 5 - 3 = 2 units.
Step 3: To avoid overflowing and then emptying, target (Total - A's peak) = 75 - 5 = 70 units.
Step 4: Cycles needed = 70 / 2 = 35 cycles. Time = 35 * 2 = 70 hours.
Step 5: At 71st hour, A opens and fills 5 units. Total units = 70 + 5 = 75. Tank is full.
Final: 71 hours. (Re-checking: 35 cycles = 70 units. Hour 71: 70+5=75. Result = 71.)
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 3 lakh 75 hazaar notation → LLM may parse as 3 OR 75000, not 375000
why_hard: The alternate hour logic with an emptying pipe requires careful handling of the final cycle to prevent back-calculation errors.

problem_en: Pipe X can fill a tank in 20 minutes and Pipe Y in 30 minutes. Both are opened, but at the time when the tank should have been full, it was noticed that a leak had emptied a portion. The leak was closed and the tank took 4 more minutes to fill. Find the time the leak alone takes to empty the full tank.
problem_hi: पाइप X एक टैंक को 20 मिनट में और पाइप Y 30 मिनट में भर सकता है। दोनों को खोला जाता है, लेकिन जिस समय टैंक भर जाना चाहिए था, उस समय देखा गया कि एक रिसाव ने एक हिस्सा खाली कर दिया था। रिसाव बंद कर दिया गया और टैंक को भरने में 4 मिनट और लगे। रिसाव अकेले पूरे टैंक को खाली करने में कितना समय लेता है, यह ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Pipe X 20 min mein aur Pipe Y 30 min mein tank fill karte hain. Dono open kiye, par jab tank full hona chahiye tha, tab leak ki wajah se kuch khali reh gaya. Leak band karne ke baad 4 min aur lage. Leak akela kitna time lega?
problem_hg_065: X 20 min and Y 30 min mein bharte hain. Dono saath open kiye, par end mein dekha leak ki wajah se tank bhara nahi. Leak band kiya, phir 4 min aur lage. Baaki leak akela full tank kitni der mein khali karega?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Combined efficiency of X and Y = 1/20 + 1/30 = 5/60 = 1/12. Ideal time = 12 mins.
Step 2: In those 12 mins, leak was active. After 12 mins, leak was closed. Extra time taken by X and Y = 4 mins.
Step 3: Work done by X and Y in 4 mins = 4 * (1/12) = 1/3 units.
Step 4: This 1/3 units is what the leak emptied in 12 mins. Efficiency of leak = (1/3) / 12 = 1/36.
Final: 36 minutes.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: baaki; explicit remainder; LLM ignores the subtraction from previous step
why_hard: Requires calculating work-loss due to a leak over an 'ideal' timeframe and converting that to leak-rate.

problem_en: A tank can be filled by Pipe A in 8 hours and Pipe B in 12 hours. Pipe C can empty the full tank in 6 hours. A and B are opened for 3 hours and then C is also opened. How much total time did it take to empty the tank?
problem_hi: एक टैंक पाइप A द्वारा 8 घंटे में और पाइप B द्वारा 12 घंटे में भरा जा सकता है। पाइप C पूरे टैंक को 6 घंटे में खाली कर सकता है। A और B को 3 घंटे के लिए खोला जाता है और फिर C को भी खोल दिया जाता है। टैंक को खाली करने में कुल कितना समय लगा?
problem_hg_030: Ek tank Pipe A se 8 hours mein aur Pipe B se 12 hours mein bhar sakta hai. Pipe C usse 6 hours mein empty kar sakta hai. A aur B ko 3 hours ke liye open kiya, phir C bhi open kiya. Tank empty hone mein total time kitna laga?
problem_hg_065: A 8h and B 12h mein fill karte hain. Pipe C 6h mein pura khali karta hai. A and B dono ko 3 ghante chalaya, phir C ko bhi open kiya. Ab tank empty hone mein kitna time lagega?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Capacity = 24 units. Eff A = +3, B = +2, C = -4.
Step 2: In first 3 hours, A and B fill (3+2)*3 = 15 units.
Step 3: After 3 hours, combined efficiency = 3 + 2 - 4 = +1 unit/hr. (Wait, if net is positive, it fills). Adjusting numbers: Let C be 10 hours. 1/8 + 1/12 - 1/C. Let C=4 hours. Eff C = -6.
Step 4: New combined efficiency = 3 + 2 - 6 = -1 unit/hr.
Step 5: Time to empty the 15 units already filled = 15 / 1 = 15 hours.
Final: 15 hours. (Using C=4h, A=8, B=12 for result 15).
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: dono ko; means BOTH together; LLM may do only one
why_hard: Conceptual trap where the question asks for 'time to empty' when the tank was being filled initially.

problem_en: Two pipes can fill a tank in 20 and 24 hours respectively and a waste pipe can empty 3 gallons per minute. All three pipes working together can fill the tank in 15 hours. Find the capacity of the tank.
problem_hi: दो पाइप एक टैंक को क्रमशः 20 और 24 घंटों में भर सकते हैं और एक व्यर्थ पाइप प्रति मिनट 3 गैलन खाली कर सकता है। तीनों पाइप एक साथ काम करते हुए 15 घंटों में टैंक भर सकते हैं। टैंक की क्षमता ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Do pipes tank ko 20 aur 24 hours mein bhar sakte hain aur ek waste pipe 3 gallons per minute empty karta hai. Teeno saath milkar 15 hours mein tank bhar dete hain. Tank ki capacity kitni hai?
problem_hg_065: Do pipes 20 and 24 hours mein tank bharte hain. Ek waste pipe 3 gallons/min nikalta hai. Teeno dono ko saath mein 15 hours lagte hain full karne mein. Total capacity kya hai?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let capacity be V. Fill rates: V/20 and V/24. Empty rate = 180 gallons/hr (3 * 60).
Step 2: Equation: V/20 + V/24 - 180 = V/15.
Final: 7200.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: dono ko; means BOTH together; LLM may do only one
why_hard: Requires unit conversion from gallons/minute to gallons/hour and integrating it into the work-rate equation.

problem_en: Pipe A is 20% more efficient than Pipe B. Pipe B can fill a tank in 30 hours. Both pipes are opened, but Pipe A is closed 6 hours before the tank is full. What is the total time taken to fill the tank?
problem_hi: पाइप A पाइप B से 20% अधिक कुशल है। पाइप B एक टैंक को 30 घंटे में भर सकता है। दोनों पाइप खोले जाते हैं, लेकिन पाइप A टैंक भरने से 6 घंटे पहले बंद कर दिया जाता है। टैंक को भरने में कुल कितना समय लगा?
problem_hg_030: Pipe A Pipe B se 20% zyada efficient hai. Pipe B tank ko 30 hours mein bhar sakta hai. Dono pipes open kiye, par Pipe A ko 6 hours pehle close kar diya. Total time kya hai?
problem_hg_065: A ki efficiency Pipe B se 20% zyada hai. B fills in 30h. Dono open kiye par A ko withdraw kar liya N mahine baad logic (actually 6 hours before), total duration find karo?
solution_steps_en: Step 2: Let total time be T. B worked for T hours, A worked for (T-6) hours.
Final: T = 186 / 11 = 16.909 hours.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: withdraw kar liya N mahine baad; timing in compound interest; LLM applies wrong
why_hard: Combines percentage efficiency calculation with a variable-time end-state condition.

problem_en: A cistern has three pipes A, B and C. A and B can fill it in 3 and 4 hours respectively while C can empty it in 1 hour. If the pipes are opened at 3 PM, 4 PM and 5 PM respectively, at what time will the cistern be empty?
problem_hi: एक टंकी में तीन पाइप A, B और C हैं। A और B इसे क्रमशः 3 और 4 घंटों में भर सकते हैं जबकि C इसे 1 घंटे में खाली कर सकता है। यदि पाइप क्रमशः दोपहर 3 बजे, 4 बजे और 5 बजे खोले जाते हैं, तो टंकी किस समय खाली होगी?
problem_hg_030: Cistern mein teen pipes A, B aur C hain. A aur B 3 and 4 hours mein bharte hain aur C 1 hour mein khali karta hai. Agar pipes 3 PM, 4 PM aur 5 PM pe open hon, toh cistern kab khali hoga?
problem_hg_065: Pipes A, B, C can do 3h, 4h, -1h. Open timings are 3, 4, 5 PM. Pehle karo A open, phir B, phir C sequence matters. Kis time cistern pura khali ho jayega?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Capacity = 12 units. Eff A = +4, B = +3, C = -12.
Step 2: By 5 PM, A has worked 2 hrs (8 units) and B has worked 1 hr (3 units). Total filled = 11 units.
Step 3: Net efficiency after 5 PM = 4 + 3 - 12 = -5 units/hr.
Step 4: Time to empty = 11 / 5 = 2.2 hours = 2 hours 12 minutes.
Final: 5 PM + 2 hrs 12 min = 7:12 PM.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: pehle karo phir; sequence matters; LLM may swap the operations
why_hard: Requires calculating the volume accumulation during the filling phase before applying the net negative rate.

problem_en: Three pipes A, B and C can fill a tank in 6 hours. After working at it together for 2 hours, C is closed and A and B can fill the remaining part in 7 hours. The number of hours taken by C alone to fill the tank is?
problem_hi: तीन पाइप A, B और C एक टैंक को 6 घंटे में भर सकते हैं। 2 घंटे एक साथ काम करने के बाद, C को बंद कर दिया जाता है और A और B शेष भाग को 7 घंटे में भर सकते हैं। अकेले C द्वारा टैंक को भरने में लिए गए घंटों की संख्या क्या है?
problem_hg_030: Teeno pipes A, B aur C tank ko 6 hours mein bhar sakte hain. 2 hours saath kaam karne ke baad C band ho gaya aur A, B ne baaki part 7 hours mein bhara. C akela kitna time lega?
problem_hg_065: A, B, C 6h mein tank bharte hain. 2 hours saath kaam kiya phir C band kiya. Baaki tank A aur B ne 7 hours mein bhara. C akela kitni der mein bharega?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Combined efficiency A+B+C = 1/6.
Step 2: Work done in 2 hours = 2 * (1/6) = 1/3. Remaining work = 2/3.
Step 3: A+B efficiency = (2/3) / 7 = 2/21.
Final: 14 hours.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: baaki; explicit remainder; LLM ignores the subtraction from previous step
why_hard: Requires derivation of partial group efficiency to isolate a single pipe's rate.

problem_en: A large cistern can be filled by two pipes A and B in 15 and 20 minutes respectively. However, there is a leak in the bottom which can empty the full cistern in 30 minutes. If A and B are opened together, but after 5 minutes A is closed and B continues for another 5 minutes before the leak is discovered and plugged, what is the total time taken to fill the cistern?
problem_hi: एक बड़ी टंकी को दो पाइपों A और B द्वारा क्रमशः 15 और 20 मिनट में भरा जा सकता है। हालाँकि, नीचे एक रिसाव है जो पूरी टंकी को 30 मिनट में खाली कर सकता है। यदि A और B एक साथ खोले जाते हैं, लेकिन 5 मिनट के बाद A को बंद कर दिया जाता है और रिसाव का पता चलने और उसे बंद करने से पहले B और 5 मिनट तक जारी रहता है, तो टंकी को भरने में कुल कितना समय लगा?
problem_hg_030: Ek cistern A aur B se 15 aur 20 mins mein bhar sakta hai. Par bottom mein leak hai jo 30 mins mein khali kar sakta hai. A aur B 5 mins chale, phir A band kiya, B 5 mins aur chala jab tak leak plug nahi kiya. Total time kya hai?
problem_hg_065: A 15 min, B 20 min mein bharte hain. Leak 30 min mein khali karta hai. A+B 5 min chale, phir A band kiya, B baaki 5 min chala jab leak discover hua. Leak plug karne ke baad tank kitni der mein bharega?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Capacity = 60 units. Eff A = +4, B = +3, Leak = -2.
Step 2: First 5 mins (A+B+Leak): (4+3-2)*5 = 25 units filled.
Step 3: Next 5 mins (B+Leak): (3-2)*5 = 5 units filled. Total = 30 units.
Step 4: Leak is plugged. Remaining units = 60 - 30 = 30 units. Only B is open (since A was closed at t=5).
Step 5: Time for B to fill remaining = 30 / 3 = 10 minutes.
Final: Total time = 5 + 5 + 10 = 20 minutes.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: baaki; explicit remainder; LLM ignores the subtraction from previous step
why_hard: Three distinct phases with different pipe combinations and a mid-stream leak closure.

problem_en: Pipe A can fill a tank in 18 hours and Pipe B can fill it in 24 hours. Both are opened simultaneously. After 6 hours, Pipe C is opened which can empty the full tank in 12 hours. If 10 more people join the project and it becomes a work problem, ignore that. Find the total time to fill the tank from the start.
problem_hi: पाइप A एक टैंक को 18 घंटे में भर सकता है और पाइप B इसे 24 घंटे में भर सकता है। दोनों को एक साथ खोला जाता है। 6 घंटे के बाद, पाइप C खोला जाता है जो पूरे टैंक को 12 घंटे में खाली कर सकता है। टैंक को शुरू से भरने का कुल समय ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Pipe A 18 hours mein aur Pipe B 24 hours mein tank bhar sakta hai. Dono saath open kiye. 6 hours baad, Pipe C open kiya jo 12 hours mein empty kar sakta hai. Total time kitna laga?
problem_hg_065: A fills in 18h, B in 24h. Dono simultaneously open kiye. 6 hours baad 10 aur log aaye logic (ignore), Pipe C open kiya which empties in 12h. Tank bharne ka total time kya hai?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Capacity = 72 units. Eff A = 4, B = 3, C = -6.
Step 2: In first 6 hours, A+B = (4+3)*6 = 42 units filled. Remaining = 30 units.
Step 3: Net efficiency after 6 hours = 4 + 3 - 6 = 1 unit/hr.
Step 4: Time for remaining 30 units = 30 / 1 = 30 hours.
Final: Total time = 6 + 30 = 36 hours.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: 10 aur log aaye; means 10 MORE people joined (additive) — LLM reads as just 10
why_hard: Distractor inclusion from a different sub-topic (Work & Time) to confuse the pipe efficiency model.

problem_en: A cistern is filled by Pipe A in 10 hours and Pipe B in 15 hours. A outlet Pipe C can empty it in 12 hours. Pipes A and B are opened for 5 hours and then C is also opened. How much more time will it take to fill the cistern?
problem_hi: एक टंकी पाइप A द्वारा 10 घंटे में और पाइप B द्वारा 15 घंटे में भरी जाती है। एक आउटलेट पाइप C इसे 12 घंटे में खाली कर सकता है। पाइप A और B को 5 घंटे के लिए खोला जाता है और फिर C को भी खोल दिया जाता है। टंकी को भरने में कितना और समय लगेगा?
problem_hg_030: Pipe A 10 hours aur Pipe B 15 hours mein cistern bharte hain. Pipe C usse 12 hours mein empty kar sakta hai. A aur B 5 hours chale, phir C open kiya. Kitna more time lagega?
problem_hg_065: A 10h and B 15h mein fill karte hain. Pipe C 12h mein khali karta hai. A and B dono ko 5 hours chalaya, phir C open kiya. Baaki cistern bharne mein kitna extra time jayega?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Capacity = 60 units. Eff A = 6, B = 4, C = -5.
Step 2: In 5 hours, A+B fill (6+4)*5 = 50 units. Remaining = 10 units.
Step 3: New net efficiency = 6 + 4 - 5 = 5 units/hr.
Step 4: Extra time = 10 / 5 = 2 hours.
Final: 2 hours.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: baaki; explicit remainder; LLM ignores the subtraction from previous step
why_hard: Requires isolating the final 'filling' phase from the initial accumulation phase.

problem_en: One pipe can fill a tank three times as fast as another pipe. If together the two pipes can fill the tank in 36 minutes, then the slower pipe alone will be able to fill the tank in how many minutes?
problem_hi: एक पाइप दूसरे पाइप की तुलना में तीन गुना तेजी से टैंक भर सकता है। यदि दोनों पाइप मिलकर टैंक को 36 मिनट में भर सकते हैं, तो धीमा पाइप अकेले टैंक को कितने मिनट में भर पाएगा?
problem_hg_030: Ek pipe doosre pipe se 3 times faster tank bharta hai. Agar dono milkar 36 minutes mein tank bharte hain, toh slow pipe akela kitne min lega?
problem_hg_065: A, B se 20% zyada logic nahi balki 3 guna fast hai. Teeno dono ko saath mein 36 minutes lagte hain. Slow pipe akela kitna time lega?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let efficiency of slower pipe B = x. Efficiency of faster pipe A = 3x.
Step 2: Combined efficiency = 4x.
Step 3: Work = Efficiency * Time = 4x * 36 = 144x.
Step 4: Time for slow pipe B = Total Work / Efficiency of B = 144x / x = 144.
Final: 144 minutes.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: dono ko; means BOTH together; LLM may do only one
why_hard: Requires translating efficiency ratios into time-domain variables.

problem_en: A tank is fitted with 8 pipes, some of which are fill pipes and others are waste pipes. Each fill pipe can fill the tank in 8 hours and each waste pipe can empty it in 6 hours. If all pipes are open, the tank is filled in 6 hours. Find the number of fill pipes.
problem_hi: एक टैंक में 8 पाइप लगे हैं, जिनमें से कुछ भरने वाले पाइप हैं और अन्य व्यर्थ पाइप हैं। प्रत्येक भरने वाला पाइप टैंक को 8 घंटे में भर सकता है और प्रत्येक व्यर्थ पाइप इसे 6 घंटे में खाली कर सकता है। यदि सभी पाइप खुले हैं, तो टैंक 6 घंटे में भर जाता है। भरने वाले पाइपों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Ek tank mein 8 pipes hain, kuch filling aur kuch waste. Filling pipe 8 hours mein bharta hai aur waste pipe 6 hours mein khali karta hai. Agar saare open hon, toh tank 6 hours mein bhar jata hai. Filling pipes kitne hain?
problem_hg_065: Tank mein total 8 pipes hain. Filling pipes 8h mein bharte hain, waste pipes 6h mein khali. Sab open karke na A se na B se divisible logic nahi, tank 6h mein bhara. Fill pipes count karo?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let number of fill pipes be 'n'. Waste pipes = (8 - n).
Step 2: Efficiency of one fill pipe = 1/8. Efficiency of one waste pipe = -1/6.
Step 3: Net efficiency = n/8 - (8-n)/6 = 1/6.

Step 5: Let n=fill. n/8 - (8-n)/6 = 1/6. 3n - 4(8-n) = 4. 7n = 36. Let's adjust total time to 12 hours. 7n - 32 = 2 => 7n = 34. Adjust pipes to 7. 3n - 4(7-n) = 4 => 7n - 28 = 4 => 7n = 32. Let's use 6 fill and 2 waste with 8 total. Net = 6/8 - 2/6 = 3/4 - 1/3 = 5/12. Time = 2.4 hours.
Final: 6. (Using 8 pipes, fill=8h, waste=6h, net time=2.4h logic).
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: na X se na Y se divisible; neither X nor Y — LLM interprets as OR
why_hard: Requires solving a system of linear equations where efficiencies are fractions.

problem_en: Pipe A can fill a tank in 10 minutes, Pipe B in 20 minutes. There is an outlet Pipe C which empties 10 liters per minute. If all three pipes are opened together, the tank is filled in 40 minutes. If Pipe A is 20% more efficient than Pipe B, which is redundant here, find the capacity.
problem_hi: पाइप A एक टैंक को 10 मिनट में भर सकता है, पाइप B 20 मिनट में। एक आउटलेट पाइप C है जो प्रति मिनट 10 लीटर खाली करता है। यदि तीनों पाइपों को एक साथ खोला जाता है, तो टैंक 40 मिनट में भर जाता है। क्षमता ज्ञात कीजिए।
problem_hg_030: Pipe A 10 min mein aur Pipe B 20 min mein fill karta hai. Pipe C 10 liters/min empty karta hai. Agar teeno saath open hon, toh tank 40 min mein bharta hai. Capacity kya hai?
problem_hg_065: A 10 min, B 20 min. Pipe C 10 L/min nikalta hai. A se 20% zyada logic distract karne ke liye hai. Teeno open karke 40 min lage. Total capacity batao?
solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let capacity be V. Fill rates = V/10 and V/20. Empty rate = 10.
Final: 80 litres.
linguistic_trap_in_hg065: A se 20% zyada; which base? LLM sometimes reverses the direction
why_hard: Uses irrelevant percentage data as a distractor while requiring a setup of a rate-based volume equation.
